ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible ventral surface exhibits a macro-level intensity ratio of approximately 80% high-intensity (white) to 20% low-intensity (black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips. Numerous discrete annular (ring-shaped) low-intensity blobs are scattered across the high-intensity white field of both lobes, with higher density in the distal thirds. A solid low-intensity patch is located at the proximal center where the fluke meets the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped medial notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 44 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge boundary displays continuous irregular micro-serrations; vertical pixel-amplitudes range from 3 to 12 pixels; serration frequency is highest at the distal extremes of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges of both lobes follow a concave curvature sweeping from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular/annular dark pixel clusters; individual rosettes range from 5 to 18 pixels in diameter; high-density clusters are located in the distal-lateral quadrants of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three to four faint, parallel, dark-gray linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the medial-proximal portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across the ventral surface and parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe.
